assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management.
The service was denied under reason code PR-204.
The appeal is being filed with the payer Lakeshore Advantage.
